source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata rewriting the Maulerfiend's [Snarling Protector](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.maulerfiend.snarling-protector):

- You may target this unit with **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** whatever other uses it has had this phase; that use costs 1 CP less and does not stop other units using it this phase.
- If an **engaged** friendly **PSYKER** unit is no more than 12″ away as the Maulerfiend declares a charge, you may re-roll its **[Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step)**, but the Maulerfiend must then finish that **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** engaged with some enemy unit that is engaged with that **PSYKER** unit.
